docs.origin_unknown: The console could not tell the public URL of the API: the snippet uses API_URL. Set apiBaseUrl in the DMS module config.
docs.auth_description: Guard found in the code: {guards}. Calls without a valid token are refused with 401.
docs.probable_description: No guard found in the code, but the route answered 401 once in {days} days. | No guard found in the code, but the route answered 401 {count} times in {days} days.
docs.unknown_description: No guard was found before or on the handler, and no 401 was seen. A check made inside the handler would not show here.
docs.inferred: Inferred from {count} successful request | Inferred from {count} successful requests
docs.no_body: No JSON body in the successful requests of the last {days} days.
docs.no_parameters: No path, query or header parameter, declared or seen.
docs.no_responses: Nothing observed in the last {days} days, and no error code found in the handler's code.
docs.observed: seen once in {days} days | seen {count} times in {days} days
docs.response_truncated: Cut when captured: the body is longer than shown.
docs.pipeline_description: What runs, in order, when this route is called

auth.manual: Your Authorization header replaces the session

tester.writes_hint: Calls the live API. A DELETE is always confirmed, and the first write on each route once per session.

blocked.path_value: {name} holds a character the tester's proxy refuses in a path (/, a space or #)
blocked.header: “{name}” is not a valid HTTP header
blocked.too_large: The request weighs {size}: the tester's proxy takes up to {limit}

tester.json_warning: Not valid JSON: {message}. It is sent as typed.
tester.body_redacted: {count} masked value, {names}: replace it before sending. | {count} masked values, {names}: replace them before sending.

body_hint.example: Prefilled from the last request this route accepted.
body_hint.no_capture: No request captured on this route in the last {days} days: write the body by hand.
body_hint.no_success: The only request of the last {days} days failed: write the body by hand. | None of the {count} requests of the last {days} days succeeded: write the body by hand.
body_hint.no_json: The successful request of the last {days} days had no JSON body: write it by hand. | No JSON body among the {count} successful requests of the last {days} days: write it by hand.
body_hint.none: No body is sent. Choose a type to add one.
body_hint.replay_missing: The body of this request was not stored ({reason}): write it by hand, or send none.
body_hint.replay_missing_unknown: The body of this request was not stored: write it by hand, or send none.
body_hint.replay_truncated: This body was cut at capture: it is not the whole request, and is replayed as text. The API gets only this part.
body_hint.replay_truncated_too_large: This body was cut at capture, so it is incomplete, and with the request around it, it is over the {limit} the tester's proxy takes: it cannot be replayed as is. Shorten it to send it.

body_omitted.not-read: answered before a handler read it

tester.redacted_value: Masked at capture: replace it with the real value
tester.headers_hint: A header named Authorization replaces your session. Credentials are never stored.
tester.marks_hint: x-request-id and x-dms-api-source are added to find the call in the logs.
tester.common_headers_hint: Sent to every route, under the headers above. Kept in this browser; credentials only until the page reloads.
tester.common_secret: {names} goes to every route, in place of your session, and is forgotten when the page reloads.
tester.query_none: No query parameter in the requests of the last {days} days. Added ones are sent as-is.
tester.query_no_capture: No request captured on this route in the last {days} days. Added parameters are sent as-is.
tester.not_captured_hint: The console's own routes are left out of the request logs: there is no captured request to show.
tester.no_response_description: Send the request ({shortcut} + Enter) to see what the route answers.
tester.waiting_description: The tester's proxy gives up after {seconds} s. Cancel to stop waiting.
tester.duration_tooltip: The browser time goes through the console's proxy; the server time is the one the module captured.
tester.truncated_in_history: Response cut in the history: {shown} of {size}.

invalid_input.title: The tester's proxy refused the request
invalid_input.description: It checks the path, the headers and the body before calling the API: nothing reached the API.

body_too_large.title: Request too large for the tester
body_too_large.description: The tester's proxy takes up to {limit} of request, body and headers included: nothing reached the API.

not_authenticated.title: Your console session has ended
not_authenticated.description: Sign in again to use the tester: nothing reached the API.

not_owner.title: The tester is for owners only
not_owner.description: The DMS lets only an owner call routes from the console: nothing reached the API.

cross_origin.title: Call refused: untrusted origin
cross_origin.description: The tester's proxy only accepts calls from the console's own origin: nothing reached the API.

proxy_failed.title: No usable answer from the API
proxy_failed.description: Either the API could not be reached, or its response is over {limit}: the tester's proxy then returns neither its status nor its body. If the call reached the API, the Captured tab shows it.
proxy_failed.description_uncaptured: Either the API could not be reached, or its response is over {limit}: the tester's proxy then returns neither its status nor its body, and the module does not capture this route.

response_too_large.title: The route answered {status}, with more than {limit}
response_too_large.description: The tester's proxy returns neither the status nor the body of a response over {limit}. The Captured tab shows what the module recorded.

timeout.title: No answer after {seconds} s
timeout.description: The tester's proxy stopped waiting. The API may still have received the call: see the Captured tab.
timeout.description_uncaptured: The tester's proxy stopped waiting. The API may still have received the call.

aborted.title: Request cancelled
aborted.description: The API may still have received and processed it: see the Captured tab.
aborted.description_uncaptured: The API may still have received and processed it.

abandoned.title: Cancelled when you left the route
abandoned.description: The call was still waiting for its answer. The API may have received and processed it: see the Captured tab.
abandoned.description_uncaptured: The call was still waiting for its answer. The API may have received and processed it.

network.title: The console's server could not be reached
network.description: {message}. Check your connection, then send again.

unauthorized.none: No credentials were sent: “Send with my session” is off.
unauthorized.manual: Your Authorization header was sent instead of your session. Remove it to use your session.
unauthorized.session: Your session token was sent: this route expects other credentials.

captured.loading: Looking for the request the module captured…
captured.missing: No captured request found for this call ({id}): capture may be off for this route, or the call never reached the API.
captured.error: Could not read the request logs.

tester.history_empty: Calls you send show up here.

tester.history_abandoned: the API may have received it
tester.secrets_not_kept: {names} was not kept: type it again to send the same request.
tester.replay_failed: Could not load the captured request
tester.replay_other_route: This captured request belongs to {route}: it was not loaded here.

replay_banner.title: Replayed from {id} ({at})
replay_banner.headers: {count} header not restored | {count} headers not restored
replay_banner.redacted: {count} masked value to fill in | {count} masked values to fill in

tester.source_failed: Not sent: the console could not mark the call as the Tester's.
tester.replay_not_found: This request can no longer be replayed: it was pruned, is outside the route scope, or matched no route.

settings.title: API settings
settings.description: Which routes the console watches, how long data is kept and what gets captured. Changes apply immediately, no restart.

sections.visibility_description: Applies to Overview, Routes and Request logs
sections.thresholds_description: When a route shows up in Needs attention

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Own routes come from your project's code. Module routes come from installed Antelope modules, like this console's own endpoints. All routes adds both.

retention.logs_description: Full requests with headers and bodies. Lowering it deletes older logs at the next hourly prune.
retention.statistics_description: Per-day aggregates behind charts and KPIs. From 60 days, 30D can be compared with the 30 days before.
retention.choice_no_comparison: No 30D comparison with the period before
retention.impact_pending: Counting what the next hourly prune deletes…
retention.impact_none: Nothing stored is older than {days} day: the next prune deletes nothing yet. | Nothing stored is older than {days} days: the next prune deletes nothing yet.
retention.impact_statistics: The next hourly prune deletes {days} day of statistics (about {requests} requests). | The next hourly prune deletes {days} days of statistics (about {requests} requests).
retention.impact_logs: The next hourly prune deletes {days} day of request logs ({requests} requests). | The next hourly prune deletes {days} days of request logs ({requests} requests).
retention.confirm_description: A lower retention deletes the data older than it at the next hourly prune. This cannot be undone.

capture.max_body_description: Larger request and response bodies are stored truncated and flagged.
capture.max_body_hint: 0 to 10,240 KB. 0 turns body capture off.
capture.headers_description: Only these request headers are stored. Add one to debug an integration, for example a webhook signature.
capture.headers_hint: Header names, stored in lower case. Secret-looking headers (authorization, cookies, API keys) are never stored.
capture.invalid_header: Not a header name: use letters, digits and dashes.
capture.redacted_description: Values under keys that match these words are replaced before storage, in bodies and query strings.

thresholds.slow_description: Requests at or above this are flagged slow; a route whose p95 reaches it is listed as Slow.
thresholds.error_rate_description: A route is flagged for its client errors when 4xx reach this share of its calls over the last 24 hours, counted from 20 calls.
thresholds.down_rate_description: API health turns Down when server errors (5xx) reach this share of the calls of the last 5 minutes, counted from 20 calls. From 1% over the last 15 minutes it is Degraded and the route Failing, then Recovered for 15 minutes once it is back.

number.adjusted_max: {typed} is above the maximum: set to {value}.
number.adjusted_min: {typed} is below the minimum: set to {value}.
number.adjusted_step: {typed} is not a step of {step}: rounded to {value}.
